description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing the standalone HTTP status responses of a gitweb interface. It sets environment variables, sources external scripts, runs Perl checks for dependencies, executes gitweb commands, and performs assertions on the output to verify correct behavior of the gitweb CGI script in various scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs commands, and checks for expected output.

methods.name: gitweb_run
methods.description: Executes the gitweb CGI script with specified parameters and captures output.
